response.justification: Although the candidate has extensive software engineering experience and a strong background in web and full-stack development, they lack the deep, recent C++ expertise required for this core C++ developer role. Furthermore, there is no evidence of experience with industrial automation protocols, IoT architectures, or the specific cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) essential for this position.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with a strong focus on architecture, TDD, and full-stack development.
Matches the advantageous skills requirement with deep expertise in Node.js, React, and cloud infrastructure.
Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and ownership through founding an open-source platform and conducting technical workshops.
concerns: Lacks recent and deep C++ experience, with the only professional C++ role being a 7-month stint in 2014-2015.
No demonstrated experience in industrial automation, IoT networking, or relevant protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA).
Missing required expertise in industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) implementation.
